users.notes: MVP seeds exactly one row ('user' / 'password', hardcoded). Password is stored as plain text for this local-only MVP; a real deployment would hash it.

boards.notes: One board per user for the MVP (user_id is unique), but the table exists separately from users so multiple boards per user is a future schema-compatible extension.

columns.notes: position is a 0-based integer determining left-to-right column order within a board. Fixed set of 5 columns per board for the MVP, but rows are ordinary DB rows (renaming is just an UPDATE).

cards.notes: position is a 0-based integer determining top-to-bottom card order within a column. Moving a card between columns updates column_id and position together.
